# Full parameter Confidence set

Build another custom legend

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
simul_data <- as.data.frame(rnorm(100))
colors <- c( 'Simultaneous strong','Pointwise weak-robust', 'Simultaneous weak-robust')
simul_data$legend <- rep(colors, length.out = 20)
# fake plot just to construct the correct legend
plot_legend <- ggplot(data =simul_data, aes(x=rnorm(100), fill = legend))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme( legend.direction = "horizontal")+
scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("darkblue", "blue", "lightblue"),
    labels = c( 'Simultaneous strong','Pointwise weak-robust', 'Simultaneous weak-robust'),
    drop=FALSE
  ) 
# Légende personnalisée (à ajuster selon vos besoins)
custom_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_legend)
plot_legend
```



Compare strong responses from both GK and MMB confidence interval sets
using the different level of precision

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
simul_data <- as.data.frame(rnorm(100))
colors <- c( 'GK 90%','GK 68%', 'MBB 90%', 'MBB 68%')
simul_data$legend <- rep(colors, length.out = 20)
# fake plot just to construct the correct legend
plot_legend <- ggplot(data =simul_data, aes(x=rnorm(100), fill = legend))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme( legend.direction = "horizontal")+
scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("darkgreen",  "lightgreen", "darkblue",  "lightblue"),
    labels = c( 'GK 90%','GK 68%', 'MBB 90%', 'MBB 68%'),
    drop=FALSE
  ) 

simul_data <- as.data.frame(rnorm(100))
colors <- c('GK 68%', 'MBB 68%')
simul_data$legend <- rep(colors, length.out = 20)
# fake plot just to construct the correct legend
plot_legend <- ggplot(data =simul_data, aes(x=rnorm(100), fill = legend))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme( legend.direction = "horizontal")+
scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("green",  "blue"),
    labels = c( 'GK 68%',  'MBB 68%'),
    drop=FALSE
  ) 
# Légende personnalisée (à ajuster selon vos besoins)
custom_legend_strong <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_legend)
plot_legend
```

```{r}
library(latex2exp)

names <- c('$P_{elec}$', '$Q_{elec}$', "IPI", '$NE Index$')

n <- length(names)
plot_irf_mini_panel_tot <- function(i){
  #i=1
  main_prediction <- lambda_0_log[, i, 1]
  time_horizon <- 1:20
  
  # strong_band_inf_GK_90 <-
  #   strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  # strong_band_sup_GK_90 <- 
  #   strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  # 
 strong_band_inf_GK_68 <-
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK_68[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  strong_band_sup_GK_68 <- 
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK_68[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  
  # strong_band_inf_MBB_90 <-
  #     strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  #   strong_band_sup_MBB_90 <- 
  #     strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  #   
   strong_band_inf_MBB_68 <-
      strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB_68[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
    strong_band_sup_MBB_68 <- 
      strong_instruments_lambda_log_MBB_68[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
    
  # Plot the responses for each variable
  
  my_plot <- ggplot()+

  geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_MBB_68,
        ymax = strong_band_sup_MBB_68), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +

    # geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_MBB_90,
    #     ymax = strong_band_sup_MBB_90), fill = "darkblue", alpha = 0.5) +

       geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_GK_68,
        ymax = strong_band_sup_GK_68), fill = "green", alpha = 0.5) +
    
      # geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf_GK_90,
      #   ymax = strong_band_sup_GK_90), fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.5) +

    # ggtitle(expression(paste(names[i]))) +
    labs(title = TeX(names[i]),
      x = "Time",
      y = "Unit Points") +
    geom_line(aes(x=time_horizon, y= main_prediction), linetype='dashed')+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
    scale_x_continuous()+
    scale_y_continuous()+
    # Add confidence bands
    theme_minimal()
  return(my_plot)
}


# Apply the function to the sequence 3:10
results <- lapply(c(1:n) , plot_irf_mini_panel_tot)

# Arrange the plots in a grid
plots_grid <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(results, nrow = 2))

final_plot <- plot_grid(plots_grid, custom_legend_strong , ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))

title <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label(TeX('$P_{elec}$ shock IRF'), fontface = 'bold', x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

# Combine the title and the final plot with legend
final_plot_with_title <- plot_grid(title, final_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

# Display the final plot
print(final_plot_with_title)
```

#Focus on the weak instruments for both bootstrap schemes

#GK botstrap scheme

```{r}
library(latex2exp)

names <- c('$P_{elec}$', '$Q_{elec}$', "IPI", '$NE Index$')

n <- length(names)
plot_irf_mini_panel_tot <- function(i){
  #i=1
  main_prediction <- lambda_0_log[, i, 1]
  time_horizon <- 1:20
  
  strong_band_inf <-
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  strong_band_sup <- 
    strong_instruments_lambda_log_GK[,i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  

  pointwise_inf_weak_band <-
    weak_instruments_pointwise_log_GK[,i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  pointwise_sup_weak_band <-
    weak_instruments_pointwise_log_GK[, i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  
  bonferroni_inf_weak_band <- 
    weak_instruments_bondferroni_log_GK[, i,"lower","lambda_01"]
  bonferroni_sup_weak_band <- 
    weak_instruments_bondferroni_log_GK[, i,"upper","lambda_01"]
  
  

  # Plot the responses for each variable
  
  my_plot <- ggplot()+

  geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = bonferroni_inf_weak_band,
        ymax = bonferroni_sup_weak_band), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +

    geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = pointwise_inf_weak_band,
        ymax = pointwise_sup_weak_band), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +

       geom_ribbon(aes(x=time_horizon, ymin = strong_band_inf,
        ymax = strong_band_sup), fill = "darkblue", alpha = 0.5) +

    # ggtitle(expression(paste(names[i]))) +
    labs(title = TeX(names[i]),
      x = "Time",
      y = "Unit Points") +
    geom_line(aes(x=time_horizon, y= main_prediction), linetype='dashed')+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'red') +
    scale_x_continuous()+
    scale_y_continuous()+
    # Add confidence bands
    theme_minimal()
  return(my_plot)
}


# Apply the function to the sequence 3:10
results <- lapply(c(1:n) , plot_irf_mini_panel_tot)

# Arrange the plots in a grid
plots_grid <- do.call("grid.arrange", c(results, nrow = 2))

final_plot <- plot_grid(plots_grid, custom_legend , ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))

title <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label(TeX('$P_{elec}$ shock IRF'), fontface = 'bold', x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

# Combine the title and the final plot with legend
final_plot_with_title <- plot_grid(title, final_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

# Display the final plot
print(final_plot_with_title)
```
